commit_message: Route AI Studio Ask through common ACP runtime
pr_title: GameEngine: integrate ACP external agent runtime
pr_body:
## Summary

- integrate common ACP transport, AgentHost bridge, Claude/Codex/Goose adapters
- route first-class AI Studio agent Ask turns through ACP with read-only Editor MCP credentials
- retain explicit Legacy routing without silent ACP fallback
- recognize ACP run-bound sessions in the existing Editor MCP active-run authority check
- keep ACP turn completion separate from Agent Host completion

## Integration

Build handoff, Managed Local/Goose selection routing, benchmark migration, Cargo.lock generation, and final validation continue on this Draft integration branch.

## Validation

Dispatcher Windows Validation is required; final integrated-head validation remains authoritative.
